This fruit plot is very small, and I keep it mixed with other plants, so I will manage it mostly with what my family can do ourselves. I do not usually buy much chemical input for a perennial plot like this because money is tight and fertilizer often comes late, but I can use manure or compost if I have some. I will keep using the planting material I know, and I do not expect to spray unless there is a serious problem. I also will not irrigate because I depend on the rains.
